evidence: Hashes: instruction.md 256c5b5d..., hireops_rules.md 38fff76c..., integration.md 1b56dd3f... all present in the r13 manifest. (1) Spelling: extracted all 645 distinct words from the three files and reviewed each by hand; no misspellings. Only variant is British 'honour'/'honouring' in instruction.md:13 versus American 'honoring'/'Honor' in integration.md:8 and hireops_rules.md:201; each file is internally consistent and both are valid spellings, so this is not a spelling error. No doubled words (regex). All three files are pure ASCII, LF, no BOM. (2) Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|lorem|TBD, host paths (C:\, /Users/, /home/, F:/), and grader vocabulary (turing|harbor|judge|rubric|criteri|reward|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|GATE|probe) across instruction.md and both notes returned zero hits. The template's 'CHANGE_ME' instruction.md and notes.md stubs have been fully replaced (notes.md was replaced by hireops_rules.md). No author asides or duplicated paragraphs. (3) Contradictions checked: accounts/password in instruction.md:17 match hireops_rules.md:11 and the 10 seed users exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, observer Aud Halvorsen, 3 candidates); 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5) = '15 seconds' (rules:117); 'most recent messages' matches the 30-message page (rules:144, seed thread_page_size 30); 'three jobs' and 'one conversation is long' (rules:206-207) match seed (3 jobs; APP-101 has 120 messages); example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair' (rules:111) uses seed names; candidate wording table (rules:183-190) equals seed candidate_status_labels; port 3000 + honour PORT (instruction.md:13) is compatible with integration.md:5 and rules:202 (PORT in launch env); '/api/health never touches the database' (instruction.md:13) is compatible with integration.md:9-10; '/assets and /instructions unavailable at runtime, copy what you need' (instruction.md:15) is compatible with integration.md:6-7 naming the seed's source path; undo 'as long as nobody has touched those cards' (instruction.md:3) is refined, not contradicted, by rules:98-99 ('Adding a note does not count as a change'). Rules:3-4 'Routes ... are yours' versus the fixed GET /api/health is the usual specific-over-general reading and instruction.md:13 explicitly says 'the other files and routes'. Counterexample search: a conforming app that reads the brief one way and the notes another (e.g. treats a note as 'touching' a card) is resolved by the more specific notes text, so no reasonable reading is contradicted; no brief text lets a broken app claim compliance through a contradiction. Non-blocking observations for the owner (not row-3 defects): (a) hireops_rules.md has uneven hard-wrapping from later edits (line 91 wraps short at 'all the rules above,'; lines 99, 112, 173 and 180 overrun the ~104-char wrap); this does not change rendered Markdown. (b) integration.md:16-19 (symlink/NODE_PATH delivery paragraph) is task-added text not present in the frozen template integration.md; it is coherent runtime guidance, not contamination, but template preservation and 'For delivery'/'submitted application' (rules:199) wording belong to rows 4/5/49 and the deterministic review. (c) The seed field generated_note references /instructions/hireops_rules.md; this is seed content (row 14), not the brief.
